findings.claim: Inverted condition in the second hunk set: `if (stringMembers.ContainsKey(...)) stringMembers.Add(...)` (missing `!`). In the field/property loop, string-keyed members are never added when the key is new, and a duplicate key makes Add throw ArgumentException. This breaks the generator/analyzer: members get silently dropped from generated formatters, and a duplicate string key crashes the collector. Dropped members mean the generated formatter does not read or write them, and the crash disables diagnostics for that type.

Assert the generated formatter includes all members. Also test with a duplicate string key to show ArgumentException instead of a diagnostic. Mutating the condition to `!ContainsKey` should make the test pass.
